scope: Full official English caption text read sequentially; no comprehensive audiovisual audit. All numeric source examples recomputed. Expected-shortfall theory and discrete examples are explicit enrichment.
source_corrections: Source USD15million/AUD20million principals at spot0.5 are inconsistent; original repaired10million/20million construction labeled separately.
Intermediate cross-currency spread surplus retains FX risk; percentages in different currencies cannot be subtracted as a guaranteed dollar fee.
Currency-leg forward conversion uses no-arbitrage, not actual future FX equal to forwards.
VaR is a lower loss quantile, not maximum possible or expected loss; strict tail can be below nominal tail mass with atoms.
Historical simulation need not assume a normal or other parametric family; synchronized risk vectors required.
For the displayed lower empirical quantile definition, n500 alpha.99 selects495th ascending/sixthlargest, unlike source fifthworst convention.
Drift and units, normal approximation versus exact GBM, and autocorrelation failure of square-root scaling stated.
Generalized ES includes fractional threshold mass; neither naive strict nor weak conditional tail means suffice with atoms.
